name: Trimethadione
aliases: Tridione®, Trimethadion, Triméthadione, Trimethadionum, Trimethinum, Troxidone
summary: Trimethadione (Tridione) is an oxazolidinedione anticonvulsant. It is most commonly used to treat epileptic conditions that are resistant to other treatments.

uses.text: It is most commonly used to treat epileptic conditions that are resistant to other treatments. It is primarily effective in treating absence seizures, but can also be used in refractory temporal lobe epilepsy.

sideEffects.text: More common adverse effects include drowsiness, hemeralopia, and hiccups.

summaryZh: 三甲雙酮（英語：Trimethadione）是噁唑烷二酮類抗驚厥劑，可用於治療其他治療難以緩解的癲癇狀況。
